request.style: English, female soulful voice, acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, Hammond organ, melancholic and resilient mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
God will tear you down forever
Snatch you from your tent and land
Uprooted from the living ground
Your strength is built on wicked ways
Trusted in your great wealth
Refused to make God your refuge
The righteous see and stand in awe
Laughing at your hollow pride

[Chorus]
But I am like a green olive tree
In the house of God I stand
I trust in God's mercy forever
Steady in his gracious hand
Like a green olive tree
In the house of God I am

[Verse]
The man who trusted in his coin
Grew strong in his own deceit
But the righteous watch his fall
Awe and laughter fill the air
He had no refuge in the Lord
Only his own wicked might
Now the tent is torn away
Up from the land of living

[Chorus]
But I am like a green olive tree
In the house of God I stand
I trust in God's mercy forever
Steady in his gracious hand
Like a green olive tree
In the house of God I am

[Bridge]
I will praise you forever
Because you have acted good
In the presence of your faithful
Hope remains in your name

[Outro]
Green olive tree in his house
Mercy forever and ever
